name: B10-0476/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns recent drone attacks on civilian and merchant ships in the Black Sea, off Bulgaria and Romania. It says these attacks break international law and threaten global food supplies. It calls for an investigation, an immediate halt to the attacks, and for Russia to respect its international commitments. It also asks EU countries to help Bulgaria and Romania detect hostile drones, and to prepare for hybrid attacks. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament asks for investigations, drone detection support and new EU defence proposals.
- **Who it affects:** Bulgaria, Romania, merchant crews, and countries depending on Black Sea grain.
- **What happens next:** EU governments and the Commission are urged to act; Bulgaria is asked to join a NATO anti-drone effort by 30 October 2026.
